title: Compatibility of Jacobian representing identifications under base change
statement: Let k ⊆ K be algebraically closed fields, C a proper smooth connected curve over k, geometrically integral, and C_K its base change, supplied with its connected-curve structure. Let J over k and JK over K be Jacobians with arbitrary degree-zero Picard representing identifications e and eK respecting multiplication. There is an isomorphism i: JK ≅ J ×_k K such that, for every K-scheme T and every fibrewise degree-zero invertible class L on C ×_k T, its transport along C_K ×_K T ≅ C ×_k T is fibrewise degree zero, and its classifying map via eK, followed by i and the projection to J, equals the classifying map of L via e.

proof.text: Construct the explicit Picard presheaf pullback isomorphism and prove it preserves the degree-zero subfunctor using fibrewise degree base-change.
Sheafify the subfunctor isomorphism, transport the representing identification through the Over.map/pullback adjunction, and compare it with the chosen base-changed representation by uniqueUpToIso.
Use sheafification naturality and representing homEquiv compatibility to derive the required equality for every test scheme and line-bundle class.
